parsed.summary: Router r2 connects to routers r1 and r3 via eth1 and eth4 respectively, providing IP forwarding. It manages three segments: a link to r1 (eth1), a server segment (eth2), and a management segment (eth3). Static routes are configured to reach the client segment via r1 and sensors via r3.

static_routes.purpose: Reach the client segment via r1
